positions.clause: The caller launches the operator with RLIMIT_CORE=(0,0) inherited, and an outer supervisor enforces 180 s wall from operator process spawn including archive staging/extraction, then kills the operator process group after a 10 s grace (absolute maximum 190 s). The AUTH totalWallSeconds=120 is only the inner native-call window measured from Runner construction after extraction, plus up to 10 s per-call kill cleanup, and is not a whole-execution cap. Failure at any bound leaves the attempt spent.
